attempt.reason: Initial decision for this persistent identity.

packet.goal: Maintain health and tolerable risk, understand unknowns through evidence, develop reusable abilities and improve personal and shared living. Choose your own questions, projects and activities; none is required.

baseline.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
Recover available physical energy at the current position.
Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.
Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
Place owned units on the ground.
Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
baseline.args: name, function, conditions, inputs, costs, effects

baseline.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
baseline.args: x: number, y: number, round: integer>=1, text

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Navigate
value.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
value.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
value.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

value.name: Learn a public interface
value.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
value.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
value.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

value.name: Gather accessible material

value.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
value.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

value.name: probe
value.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
value.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
value.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.
